summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to allow dietary supplements, up to $500 per year, to be considered qualified medical expenses for health savings accounts (HSAs), Archer medical savings accounts (MSAs), health flexible spending arrangements, and health reimbursement arrangements, starting in 2026.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to allow dietary supplements to be considered qualified medical expenses for HSAs, Archer MSAs, and health flexible spending arrangements. This change would effectively lower the taxable income for individuals utilizing these accounts for dietary supplement purchases, thus reducing tax revenue.
